description:
Pre-existing clippy warnings in crate-jmap-mail-types/src/mdn.rs:756-758 fail 'cargo clippy --workspace --tests -- -D warnings':

```
error: use of a fallible conversion when an infallible one could be used
   --> crate-jmap-mail-types/src/mdn.rs:756:26
   --> crate-jmap-mail-types/src/mdn.rs:757:27
   --> crate-jmap-mail-types/src/mdn.rs:758:23
```

Three adjacent test-code sites use Id::try_from("...").unwrap() where Id::from("...") would do, given Id implements From<&str> infallibly (Id is #[serde(transparent)] over String, intentionally permissive — see workspace AGENTS.md). Clippy autofix suggestion:

```diff
-        let blob_id = Id::try_from("b1").unwrap();
+        let blob_id = Id::from("b1");
```

Discovered while running pre-commit gate for JMAP-tjvm.37 (queryChanges wire-shape regression tests sweep). The file was NOT touched by that work — this is pre-existing.

Fix is mechanical: replace 3 try_from(&str).unwrap() with from(&str). Out of scope for any feature/test bead.

Companion clippy beads from the same workspace run: JMAP-79qy / JMAP-taw2 (needless_borrows in metadata_types test), JMAP-l35v (type_complexity in jscontact-types lib test), JMAP-z26e (doc_list_item_without_indentation in email.rs). One more untracked error to file.
title: (BUG) clippy unnecessary_fallible_conversions in jmap-mail-types mdn.rs (3 sites)
